results.actor: Zero/one object result. Valid string account ID and uncoerced string tenant; absent session or tenant retains denial.
results.profile: Zero/one object with valid string profile ID; absent profile retains 404.
results.aggregate: Exactly one object with the existing nonnegative safe-integer total.
results.page: Object-row array no larger than the requested validated limit, including summary groups.
results.detail: Zero/one object; present ID matches the requested route ID exactly. Nested payment parent invoice is checked before payment lookup.
results.singleton: Zero/one object; no new caller-selected identity.

authority: No new routes, grants, unapproved summary routes or business writes.
verification: Gateway fixtures and disposable UUID/text PostgreSQL checks remain separate from production verification.
